ilmxlab--lost-droids.idea_en: Star Wars droids show up in a real office and project a hologram message for you.
ilmxlab--lost-droids.technique_zh: 实时渲染的角色锚定在实体房间中，并直接透过原型机的光学系统拍摄。
ilmxlab--lost-droids.exercise_en: Use phone AR to have a character in the classroom "project" a recorded video message by playing a video plane above it. Twist: the message plays only when two people watch at the same time.

mit-tangible-media--materiable.description_zh: 一台形状显示器能呈现弹性、黏性和柔韧性等材料属性，触摸针阵时的手感就像在按压果冻、沙子或橡胶。
mit-tangible-media--materiable.idea_en: The same pin surface turns into jelly, sand or rubber under your hand.
mit-tangible-media--materiable.technique_zh: 通过针脚电机电流进行力感知，检测每根针被按压的力度，再由逐针的物理模型（弹簧、阻尼、流体耦合）设定针的响应，模拟弹性或黏性，并用投影显示材料外观。
mit-tangible-media--materiable.exercise_en: Use touchscreen pressure or press duration as input to render a block of virtual material (jelly, sand, rubber) on an AR plane, and make it respond differently to presses using spring, damping and diffusion models, with vibration feedback. Twist: invent a material that does not exist in reality.

zach-lieberman--m-s-que-la-cara.description_zh: 休斯敦市中心的一件公共装置，追踪路人的面孔，并叠加数十种生成式插画面具，面具会随眉毛、嘴唇和头部的动作而变化。
zach-lieberman--m-s-que-la-cara.idea_en: "More than a face": a magic mirror in public space that turns passers-by's faces into generative masks that follow their expressions.
zach-lieberman--m-s-que-la-cara.technique_zh: 2D 面部特征点追踪器（FaceTracker 类）在实时相机画面中为每张脸拟合数十个点，矢量插画的面具部件蒙皮到眉毛、嘴唇和头部特征点上，随表情一起变形。
zach-lieberman--m-s-que-la-cara.exercise_en: Draw a mask made only of geometric lines with MediaPipe Face Mesh and p5.js, with eyebrow and mouth landmarks driving the shapes. Twist: give each person a random new mask as soon as they come close, with 10 styles to "swap faces" for passers-by.

novum-analytics--night-terrors.description_zh: 一款戴着耳机在漆黑的家中游玩的生存恐怖游戏：手机成为看见那些在你自己房间里游荡的怪物和幽灵的唯一途径。
novum-analytics--night-terrors.idea_en: Lights off, headphones on, and your own home becomes a horror game full of monsters.
novum-analytics--night-terrors.technique_zh: 手机相机画面被调暗，并由一支虚拟手电筒照亮；幽灵以精心设计的惊吓时机叠加出现，并通过耳机播放空间音频。
novum-analytics--night-terrors.exercise_en: Build a scene where AR content appears only inside the phone's "flashlight" circle, paired with directional sound in headphones. Twist: the smaller the circle, the closer the horror gets.

yuta-itoh--ost-rift.description_zh: 把一台消费级 VR 头显改装成光学透视式 AR 显示器，并精细处理时序，使虚拟物体在头部运动时仍然牢牢锁定在现实世界中。
yuta-itoh--ost-rift.idea_en: A VR headset converted to optical see-through AR, with virtual objects pinned firmly to reality.
yuta-itoh--ost-rift.technique_zh: 为 Rift 加装分光镜光学组件，并预测头部位姿以补偿显示延迟，使叠加内容与真实场景在时间上保持一致。
yuta-itoh--ost-rift.exercise_en: Build simple see-through AR glasses from HoloKit or a phone plus a half-mirror, and compare how a virtual cube drifts during fast head turns. Twist: add an artificial 200 ms delay and have classmates describe how it feels.

trixi-studios--phantogeist.description_zh: 一款运行在 Project Tango 手机上的第一人称射击游戏，无需任何标记，就能在任何地方——从小房间到足球场——在你周围生成幽灵敌人和环境。
trixi-studios--phantogeist.idea_en: A first-person ghost shooter for any real space, with the game adapting to the size of the site.
trixi-studios--phantogeist.technique_zh: Tango 的 inside-out 运动追踪提供 6DoF 位姿，使敌人可以放置在世界坐标中，游戏区域也会根据可用的实际空间自动缩放。
trixi-studios--phantogeist.exercise_en: Build a small game with AR Foundation that spawns monsters on a sports field, with enemies walking in from the distance. Twist: enemies flying in the air can only be seen when you hold the phone up high.

trixi-studios--phantogeist-coop.description_zh: 两台 Tango 设备共享同一场幽灵战斗，一名玩家可以拍摄另一名玩家与虚拟敌人战斗的画面，自动生成混合现实视频。
trixi-studios--phantogeist-coop.idea_en: Two devices share one battle: one person plays, the other films, and mixed-reality video comes out automatically.
trixi-studios--phantogeist-coop.technique_zh: 两台设备都定位到同一个共享坐标系中（大概率通过 Tango 区域学习），使敌人对每位玩家都出现在同一个物理位置。
trixi-studios--phantogeist-coop.exercise_en: Build a two-player game with 8th Wall or Lens Studio shared sessions, or an ARKit collaborative session, where one person fights monsters and the other films. Twist: the camera operator's lens can "freeze" the monsters.

shunichi-kasahara--parallel-eyes.description_zh: 四个人戴着头显，同时看到所有人的第一人称视角分屏画面，然后在同时透过所有人的身体观看的状态下，尝试玩捉迷藏并相互配合。
shunichi-kasahara--parallel-eyes.idea_en: Four people see through each other's eyes at once and play hide-and-seek with shared vision.
shunichi-kasahara--parallel-eyes.technique_zh: 把每位参与者头戴相机的画面实时传输到一个共享的平铺视频布局中，并显示在每台头显里；这是与 YCAM 的合作作品。
shunichi-kasahara--parallel-eyes.exercise_en: Have four classmates join a video call with their phones' front or rear cameras, show all feeds side by side, and play a find-the-person game wearing phone viewers. Twist: randomly swap the position of your feed with someone else's.

niantic--pok-mon-go.description_zh: 玩家在自己的街区里走动寻找宝可梦，它们会出现在相机画面中的真实街道上，玩家投出精灵球来捕捉；道馆和团体战则把玩家聚集到地标处。
niantic--pok-mon-go.idea_en: Pokémon show up on your street corner, and you collect them by walking and using the camera.
niantic--pok-mon-go.technique_zh: GPS 与刷新表把小精灵放在地图位置附近，遭遇界面借助陀螺仪朝向（而非完整的 SLAM）把小精灵叠加在相机画面上。
niantic--pok-mon-go.exercise_en: Use the gyroscope to control a character overlaid on the camera image that can be seen only when you face the right direction, and swipe to throw a ball and catch it. Twist: the character appears only in certain weather or at certain times.

yannick-jacquet--remote-memories.description_zh: 一件由投影映射面板和声音构成的全景多联画，缓缓拼合出一幅由记忆组成的画面风景，也曾以现场演出的形式呈现。
yannick-jacquet--remote-memories.idea_en: Fragments of memory pieced into a panoramic projection you have to take in slowly.
yannick-jacquet--remote-memories.technique_zh: 视频被映射到多块大小和深度各不相同的实体面板上，使单一画面构图横跨整幅多联画。
yannick-jacquet--remote-memories.exercise_en: Arrange five whiteboards of different sizes into a polyptych and project an animation of old photos across all the panels. Twist: each panel stands for a fragment of memory told by a different person.

microsoft-hololens--roboraid.description_zh: 外星机器人冲破你家真实的墙壁闯进来，留下裂痕；你用注视和空中点击射击它们，同时还要真实地闪躲飞来的弹丸。
microsoft-hololens--roboraid.idea_en: Alien robots break in through the real walls of your home.
microsoft-hololens--roboraid.technique_zh: 利用空间映射网格选取墙面上的生成点并渲染裂痕贴花，同时用空间音频提示玩家身后的敌人。
microsoft-hololens--roboraid.exercise_en: Detect vertical walls in phone AR and generate "broken hole" decals with enemies crawling out of them, which players shoot by tapping a crosshair. Twist: signal enemy positions with sound alone.

msr-benko-wilson--room2room.description_zh: 真人大小的远程临场：远方的人被 3D 捕捉后投影到你的房间里，以正确的比例坐在你真实的沙发上。
msr-benko-wilson--room2room.idea_en: Project a faraway person at life size onto your sofa, with no headset required.
msr-benko-wilson--room2room.technique_zh: Kinect 把远端的人捕捉为带颜色的深度网格，借助投影仪—相机标定以及本地用户的头部追踪，把其以真人大小、经透视校正后渲染到一件真实家具上。
msr-benko-wilson--room2room.exercise_en: Cut out a remote classmate from their video with MediaPipe Selfie Segmentation, project them at life size sitting on a real local chair, and talk over a video call. Twist: the remote person appears only when you look at the chair.

msr-benko-wilson--snaptoreality.description_zh: AR 中的虚拟物体会自动吸附到真实世界的边缘和平面上，让全息影像与家具的精确对齐变得毫不费力。
msr-benko-wilson--snaptoreality.idea_en: Holograms snap onto real table edges and walls, like the snap-to-align guides in slide software.
msr-benko-wilson--snaptoreality.technique_zh: 从深度数据中实时提取平面和主要边缘，当被操作的虚拟物体进入距离和角度阈值范围内时，便吸附到最近的对齐约束上。
msr-benko-wilson--snaptoreality.exercise_en: In AR Foundation, make a virtual picture frame snap to the nearest detected plane and plane edge while being dragged, when it is within 5 cm. Twist: design an "anti-snap" so some objects always float away from real surfaces.

can-buyukberber--unifield.description_zh: 一件基于 Coxeter 高维几何的激光切割雕塑，经过投影映射后，光线仿佛揭示出一个在其中旋转穿行的四维物体。
can-buyukberber--unifield.idea_en: Projection mapping on a laser-cut sculpture makes it look like a 4D object is passing through it.
can-buyukberber--unifield.technique_zh: 投影映射把渲染的动画与制作完成的雕塑切面精确对齐，使虚拟的光与运动看起来就存在于实体形态之上。
can-buyukberber--unifield.exercise_en: Fold a polyhedron from cardboard and use projection mapping to light up its faces in sequence, creating the illusion of rotation. Twist: change the direction of the rotating light when viewers walk by, detected with a camera.

chris-oshea--wilderness-wiggle.description_zh: 为阿拉斯加原住民医疗中心的孩子们打造的一面体感阿拉斯加荒野游戏墙，孩子们的动作会让动物和风景做出回应。
chris-oshea--wilderness-wiggle.idea_en: A motion-sensing wilderness play wall in an Alaskan hospital where animals and landscape answer children's movements.
chris-oshea--wilderness-wiggle.technique_zh: 深度相机追踪身体轮廓和动作，并将其映射为游戏墙上会做出回应的动物和风景动画。
chris-oshea--wilderness-wiggle.exercise_en: Pick a natural landscape from your hometown and build a motion-sensing wall with a camera and p5.js where movement makes local animals appear or hide. Twist: ask a classmate from a different place to supply animals and sounds so the wall tells the story of their place.

asobo-studio--young-conker.description_zh: 一款 HoloLens 平台游戏，会扫描你的房间，并以程序化方式把家具和地面变成关卡，让松鼠 Conker 在上面奔跑。
asobo-studio--young-conker.idea_en: Scan the room and automatically turn furniture and floors into platformer levels.
asobo-studio--young-conker.technique_zh: 分析房间网格中可行走的水平表面，由程序化关卡生成器在真实家具上布置平台、收集品和路径。
asobo-studio--young-conker.exercise_en: Find all horizontal surfaces in a room with plane detection and automatically generate jump paths and coins between them. Twist: make the character slip off the edges of real objects.

nobumichi-asai--connected-colors.description_zh: 基于面部追踪的投影映射，让植物、鸟和纹样随表演者的动作在她的脸上同步绽放。
nobumichi-asai--connected-colors.idea_en: Flower and bird patterns bloom live on a tracked face.
nobumichi-asai--connected-colors.technique_zh: 实时面部追踪数据输入投影仪—相机系统，在面部 UV 空间中渲染动画纹样，使头部转动时植物和鸟仿佛从皮肤上生长出来。
nobumichi-asai--connected-colors.exercise_en: In TouchDesigner, drive a pattern-growing animation with MediaPipe face landmarks and project it onto the face of a classmate wearing a white mask. Twist: make the growth speed follow the music or the sound of breathing.

daito-manabe--live-ar-system.description_zh: 一次面向舞台演出的实时 AR 系统测试，在转播摄像机移动时，虚拟图形始终锚定在实体舞台上。
daito-manabe--live-ar-system.idea_en: A live AR system that locks virtual graphics to the real stage during a live broadcast.
daito-manabe--live-ar-system.technique_zh: 带追踪功能（编码器或光学方式）的转播摄像机把位姿和镜头数据传给实时引擎，引擎渲染出锚定在舞台上、与摄像机视角匹配的图形。
daito-manabe--live-ar-system.exercise_en: Use a phone as the "broadcast camera" and add fixed virtual lights and scenery to a small tabletop stage in Unity AR while another classmate performs on it. Twist: make the virtual scenery change with the performer's voice volume.

elevenplay-mikiko--24-drones.description_zh: 三位舞者与 24 架发光无人机同台演出；无人机组成流动的光之星座，回应并框定舞蹈编排。
elevenplay-mikiko--24-drones.idea_en: Twenty-four glowing drones form a dancing constellation of light.
elevenplay-mikiko--24-drones.technique_zh: 室内动作捕捉系统对 24 架定制发光无人机（由 Motoi Ishibashi 设计）进行定位，其灯光和位置均根据编舞进行编程。
elevenplay-mikiko--24-drones.exercise_en: Have 24 classmates each hold a phone flashlight and walk in the dark to coordinates given by a projection, forming shapes. Twist: generate the shapes in real time from a dancer's pose.

pedro-lopes--affordance-plus-plus.description_zh: 物体借助 EMS 驱动用户自己的手，“告诉”用户该如何使用它们：抓起喷漆罐时手会自动摇晃它，碰到烫手的杯子时手会自动缩回。
pedro-lopes--affordance-plus-plus.idea_en: Objects use electrical stimulation to teach your hand directly how to use them.
pedro-lopes--affordance-plus-plus.technique_zh: 检测手正在接近哪个物体，并在前臂肌肉上施加预先录制的 EMS 模式，让手做出该物体预期的使用动作。
pedro-lopes--affordance-plus-plus.exercise_en: Stick QR codes on a few objects in the classroom, recognize them in phone AR, and overlay "animated usage hints" (shaking, rotating arrows) on the hand. Twist: express the hints as phone vibration rhythms instead of images.
